rules.source_statement: Chapter L opens below the divider on PDF353, 'Of Servants fled, Beasts strayed, and things lost'.

rules.source_statement: The Moon is assigned as general significator of the thing lost, with application to first lord, twelfth-from-first or Moon's house-lord used for finding it.

exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Preserve three alternative named application targets and original house relation.

rules.source_statement: If Moon applies to none of those and does not occupy the ascendant or second, Lilly denies finding the missing possession.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Negative depends on absence of all named conditions and Moon positions.

rules.source_statement: If the lord of the Moon's domicile is in the third, or in sextile to ascendant, Lilly offers hope of finding the missing property DURING THAT ASPECT WITH THE ASCENDING DEGREE.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The hope claim is limited to the aspect's operative period with the ascending degree; not an outcome guarantee.

rules.source_statement: The Moon's house lord separated from rulers of 6th, 8th or 12th and applies to second-house cusp predicts recovery, regardless of applying aspect.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Both prior separation and new application required, distinct temporal stages.

rules.source_statement: The lord of the Moon's own house beholding the Moon is one source hope of return; the next printed sentence says that when these configurations are found CONTRARY, the judgment is likewise contrary.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Moon's domicile lord must behold Moon; contrary aspect/configuration yields a separately adverse judgment, not an honest-finder person-type.

rules.source_statement: The Moon's eastern versus western zodiacal character is interpreted as east versus west location of a lost thing.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historical orientation method, no modern coordinates.

rules.source_statement: Separately from the Moon-house ruler's human/animal signs, Lilly interprets the MOON placed in a fiery or watery sign as indicating a place with fire or water.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Only the Moon's own fiery or watery placement in this sentence; small-beast signs ♈ and ♑ belong to the ruler of Moon's house in a separate clause.

rules.source_statement: If Moon and ascendant lord occupy the same quarter and have not more than ONE SIGN between them, the missing thing is said to be IN THE HOUSE of the person who lost it.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Preserve one whole Sign as original distance unit, not a generic one-to-30-degree computation; source says the loser's house, not vague proximity.

rules.source_statement: Moon and ascendant ruler in one quarter with thirty-to-seventy degree separation is said to locate an object within owner's town.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Thresholds original text; this differs from later moon-aspect distance rule.

rules.source_statement: Moon and first lord not in the same quarter are said to indicate a distant location.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No quantified geographical validation.

rules.source_statement: Subsection 'How the thing or Goods was lost' asks about the first ruler's most recent separation.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Interpret the actual last separated planet, not future application.

rules.source_statement: First lord separating from Saturn is attributed to forgetting the object, possibly by coldness or sickness, especially if Saturn retrograde.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historical physiology/memory explanation, not clinical diagnosis.

rules.source_statement: First-house lord separating from JUPITER, OR being in Jupiter's house, is associated with business, justice, governance, a fast/abstinency or caring for important affairs when the property was lost.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: These are source's hypothetical circumstances and alternatives, not verified reasons or real officials. Original printed marginal critique about Friarly astrology/Abbey/Nunnery is separate testimony.

rules.source_statement: The ascendant lord separating from MARS, OR situated in the house of Mars, is associated by Lilly with fear, sudden passion, anger, fire, enemies or quarrels as possible original circumstances of the loss.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The required prior separating planet or first lord in Mars's house is explicit; these are unconfirmed alternatives, not reliable causes.

rules.source_statement: The ascendant lord separating from SUN, OR situated in the house of Sun, is associated by Lilly with a king/great person, hunt, pastime or authority as possible original circumstances of the loss.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The required prior separating planet or first lord in Sun's house is explicit; these are unconfirmed alternatives, not reliable causes.

rules.source_statement: The ascendant lord separating from VENUS, OR situated in the house of Venus, is associated by Lilly with drink, cards, dice, music, tavern or time with women as possible original circumstances of the loss.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The required prior separating planet or first lord in Venus's house is explicit; these are unconfirmed alternatives, not reliable causes.

rules.source_statement: Separating from Mercury is associated with writing, delivering or dictating letters, or sending a message.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Keep Mercury source attribution independent of Moon/lostness.

rules.source_statement: Separating from Moon or being in Moon's house is attributed to frequent/common use, a messenger, widow or servant.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Moon branch is not a separate observed case.

rules.source_statement: For a lost living BEAST instead of things not having life, Lilly introduces separate questions whether it fled voluntarily, was driven/taken, survives or died, and if dead the supposed cause.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This is a source scope change from inanimate goods to beasts; no observed death or cause established.

rules.source_statement: Heading 'Whether it be stolen or no' begins a livestock-specific decision, continuing onto next original page.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This early heading is distinct from later formal 'Of a Thief and Theft' section.

rules.source_statement: If Moon's house lord separates from some other planet, the beast is said to have fled on its own.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Direction of separation is crucial: lord of Moon's house separates from another.

rules.source_statement: If another planet separates from the lord of Moon's house, the beast is said to be taken or driven away.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Reverse direction, not identical to self-flight.

rules.source_statement: Only AFTER checking both the Moon's house lord AND the second-house lord for the specified separating relation, if neither shows separation, Lilly says the beast still remains where it was.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: R2162 is the second-lord fallback; no-separation conclusion requires failure of BOTH comparisons, not Moon-house lord alone.

rules.source_statement: If Moon's domicile lord exhibits no relevant separation, ALSO inspect the second-house lord in the SAME manner; the latter is the next prescribed check BEFORE calling the beast still in place.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source fallback order: lunar domicile lord -> second-house lord -> combined nonseparation inference. R2161 states the final conclusion.

rules.source_statement: If the Moon applies to the LORD OF THE EIGHTH HOUSE COUNTED FROM THE MOON, Lilly says the missing beast is dead.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The eighth FROM Moon is not the radical eighth house; animal death is unverified historic assertion.

rules.source_statement: If the Moon's domicile ruler applies to the LORD OF THE EIGHTH FROM THE MOON, the beast is said to be dead OR TO DIE VERY SHORTLY.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Retain from-Moon derived house and the printed soon-to-die alternative, not near-death or source-independent medical evidence.

rules.source_statement: When Moon and her house lord do not make the preceding contacts with the eighth FROM Moon, Lilly instructs a LAST resort using the LORD OF THE RADICAL EIGHTH HOUSE.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: A genuine different fallback significator; do not replace both prior Moon-derived eighth lords with radical eighth.

rules.source_statement: Thief significator in ascendant, or transmitting virtue to Moon, or Moon transmitting virtue to it, is associated with a stolen missing thing.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Role direction and original signifiers must be preserved.

rules.source_statement: An application from ASCENDANT LORD to the alleged thief significator is one source theft claim; ALTERNATIVELY, the thief significator APPLYING to ascendant lord BY SQUARE OR OPPOSITION is another.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Asymmetrical source directions: specific square/opposition is printed for thief-to-first contact, not automatically for both.

rules.source_statement: The source lists Moon and lords of her house, term and second, and the Part-of-Fortune-like body, in possible contacts WITH THE ALLEGED THIEF SIGNIFICATOR; it does not say Moon directly aspects every listed lord.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Printed grammar is elliptical; preserve the list as candidates in the alleged thief-contact test and retain ambiguity rather than inventing extra Moon aspects.

rules.source_statement: Absence of theft contacts suggests no theft, EXCEPT that an INFORTUNE IN ASCENDANT OR SECOND, or the Moon-house/term lord, Part of Fortune OR ITS OWN LORD unfortunate, are explicitly said to signify LOSS/LOSING.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Author's negative conclusion has exceptions and can still mean LOSING (not independently proven theft); preserve Part-of-Fortune lord.

rules.source_statement: For strayed beasts/fugitives/lost property, Moon applying to first or second lord or own dispositor is offered for recovery.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This is a new general heading and combines three topic types.

rules.source_statement: Moon in ascendant or Moon's dispositor in trine/sextile provides hope of recovery.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Moon itself in first vs dispositor aspect are alternatives.

rules.source_statement: Moon's domicile ruler separating from sixth/eighth/twelfth lord and then applying to the FIRST HOUSE LORD OR THE DEGREE/CUSP OF SECOND is an alleged favourable sign.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The print does not name an application to second-house RULER here; do not insert it as a third option.

rules.source_statement: If the Moon is afflicted by rulers of sixth/eighth/twelfth, particularly when an infortune beholds her under the named configuration, Lilly suspects goods retained by a harmful person.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The especially-if infortune aspect qualifies intensity; allegations of dishonesty have no real evidentiary basis.

rules.source_statement: Moon's favourable relation to Jupiter or Venus suggests an HONEST FINDER WHO WILL RESTORE GOODS; the printed conditional may also attach fortunate Jupiter/Venus aspecting the ascendant or Moon applying to ascendant to this helpful-returner branch.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Preserve the source's strong WILL wording as AUTHORIAL claim. Attachment of the next if clause is ambiguous and is not proof of actual honesty.

rules.source_statement: MOON IN THE ASCENDANT is specifically said to signify that the lost thing is RESTORED WITH TROUBLE OR PAIN.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not attach the trouble/pain outcome only to Jupiter/Venus aspect or Moon applying to ascendant; source has Moon IN first.

rules.source_statement: Twelfth lord in twelfth or seventh lord in twelfth is claimed to mean fugitive imprisoned.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historic servitude/policing allegation, no verified custody data.

rules.source_statement: Moon in tenth is read south, seventh west, fourth north, first east for direction of missing thing.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: House-angle directional convention, no coordinates.

rules.source_statement: Lunar dispositor in a human sign is associated with a location frequented by people.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Signs are traditional categories; not a search warrant.

rules.source_statement: If the relevant lunar house lord is in Cancer, Scorpio or Pisces, Lilly suggests wells/water; if Moon occupies the LAST FACE of Capricorn, he suggests ships, BUT ONLY WHEN goods went missing near a harbour.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Sign glyphs ♋ ♏ ♓ and last-face ♑ are source-explicit; the antecedent house-lord/Moon subject is potentially unclear. Harbour is a precondition not a guaranteed location.

rules.source_statement: Moon in a fiery sign is read as near fire. In a separate clause, Moon or Moon-house ruler in MOVABLE sign signifies new-PEOPLED place, new houses, hills or LEVEL/NEWLY BROKEN-UP ground.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not reduce 'broken up/newly peopled' to a validated geographical fact.

rules.source_statement: Within the relevant quarter, Moon/ascendant-lord separation under the source's degree threshold is taken to indicate THE MISSING THING near its owner, with greater separation implying farther.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source wording refers to the lost thing, not necessarily a living beast. Competing quarter schemes remain unverified.

rules.source_statement: Another planet separating from Moon's house lord suggests theft; Moon's house lord separating from another indicates wandering.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This restates direction polarity from prior beast rule.

rules.source_statement: For a missing LIVING beast, the MOON OR HER DOMICILE LORD applying to the radical eighth lord OR TO THE EIGHTH FROM THE MOON is claimed to signify it is dead OR WILL DIE SHORTLY.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Four printed candidate contact routes must not be compressed into one. This is not an inanimate object's 'death' or modern animal prognosis.

rules.source_statement: MOON in ascendant, OR Moon in TRINE to the lord of ascendant, OR Moon in TRINE to the SUN, is offered as a favourable recovery reading.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The Sun glyph is readable on PDF358, not a speculative unidentified planet.

rules.source_statement: Second-house lord in ninth or tenth indicates missing goods may be in the querent's house or with a familiar friend, without establishing a thief.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No positive independent evidence that any particular acquaintance possesses the goods; separate the second lord in 11th/12th far-away clause.

rules.source_statement: SUN in ascendant is interpreted as finding lost goods, EXCEPT when the original source says SUN in LIBRA ♎ or AQUARIUS ♒.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: These two zodiac exception glyphs are legible; historical source claim only.

rules.source_statement: An independent heading 'Of Beasts or Strayes' begins explicit livestock-house location scheme.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not another numbered chapter.

rules.source_statement: Sixth-house ruler in sixth indicates small beasts; twelfth ruler in twelfth indicates larger beasts.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Both conditions refer to respective beast category, not generic house size.

rules.source_statement: Sixth lord in sixth/twelfth suggests animals in a pound, enclosure or official custody.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not equate every sixth ruler in its domicile with captured animals outside this context.

rules.source_statement: Sixth lord in fiery signs is assigned animals under fetters/locks.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Old animal-custody inference, not real observation.

rules.source_statement: Moon in common signs points to rushy grounds; Moon angular to CLOSES/GROUNDS, succedent to nearby closes at owner's RIGHT HAND, and cadent to COMMON FIELDS.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The word common in common fields is source-explicit; placements are alternatives with distinct labels.

rules.source_statement: Moon in CANCER ♋ is read as a den or water-beast place or little rivulet; AQUARIUS ♒ or PISCES ♓ as watery/fishing places or near fishponds; Moon in LAST MOIETY OF CAPRICORN ♑ as ships, wood or a wood-yard.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not add generic 'other watery signs'. The p323 last-FACE versus p324 last-MOIETY Capricorn wording is a visible cross-page discrepancy.

rules.source_statement: Fiery Moon sign suggests former/current fire; airy signs many windows, garrets or open places; earthly signs mud/clay or earthen walls, separately labelled 'This concerns Goods immovable' in printed marginal text.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: A star-marked sentence following concerns beasts strayed, not all immutable goods. Elemental symbolism is not observed navigation.

rules.source_statement: Moon OR lord of her own domicile in MOVABLE signs indicates new people, recently built houses, hills or newly broken-up LEVEL ground; the printed star note says the linked part has relation to BEASTS STRAYED.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not omit source margin switch from immovable goods to beasts; no identified real site.

rules.source_statement: Moon in FIXED sign is interpreted as plain country/champion; Moon in COMMON sign as place of much water, according to whether the thing lost was movable or live.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Printed marginal context concerns beasts strayed for part of the passage; the earlier source also uses fixed signs to mean low hiding places, a retained disagreement.

rules.source_statement: Heading 'Another Judgment' begins different sign-type rules for locating lost objects or beasts.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source switches technique; do not silently merge with lunar-ruler method.

rules.source_statement: Common signs GEMINI, VIRGO, SAGITTARIUS, PISCES indicate INANIMATE/DEAD THINGS such as rings within HOUSE; LIVING beasts suggest watery grounds, pits, rushes or MARKETPLACE.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: All four sign glyphs legible in original. Do not interchange dead goods with livestock.

rules.source_statement: Fixed signs are read as property hidden near ground, inside walls or hollow trees.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not a universal sign-to-location invariant across preceding methods.

rules.source_statement: Movable signs are read as HIGH places, ceilings or roofs; watery signs as IN WATER OR UNDER THE EARTH, pavement or foundations.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not convert the watery rule to merely 'under water'. These are source-place conjectures.

rules.source_statement: SIXTH LORD UNFORTUNATE by SATURN or MARS predicts beasts lost, driven away OR STOLEN, CHIEFLY IF the sixth lord is CADENT.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Cadency intensifies but isn't a required prerequisite.

rules.source_statement: Another planet SEPARATING FROM lunar house lord OR second lord indicates beast DRIVEN AWAY OR SOLD; if none of these separations, it is NOT FAR.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not only stolen: sold is an alternative, 'none' scope may cover adjacent source options.

rules.source_statement: Moon applying to LORD OF EIGHTH OR THE EIGHTH HOUSE, OR Moon-house lord applying to eighth, signifies death; beast's significator IN EIGHTH and SQUARE TO AN INFORTUNE IN FOURTH is another alleged mortality claim.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Preserve eighth-house direct application, fourth-house malefic location, and unusual geometry.

rules.source_statement: SIXTH/TWELFTH LORD in NINTH OR TENTH allegedly places cattle with JUSTICE/OFFICER, under LOCK or ordered to be KEPT SAFE.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: These are conditional 1647 custodial claims, no actual officer or animal.

rules.source_statement: FOR THE MOST PART, sixth OR twelfth lord IN TWELFTH OR SIXTH predicts beasts KEPT CLOSE IN POUND.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Either lord in either printed house, source hedge preserved.

rules.source_statement: Sixth-house lord fortunate by Jupiter or Venus, AND found in the SECOND, FIFTH OR ELEVENTH houses, gives Lilly's prediction that cattle shall be recovered.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: FIFTH, not sixth; source uses ambiguous 'they be found' for the beneficiary/animal placement. Conditional conjunction and authorial scope retained.

rules.source_statement: Lunar term lord or fourth-cusp ruler joined to first ruler provides another favourable cattle-recovery indication.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historical term/cusp method; require source-defined rulership.

rules.source_statement: SIXTH OR TWELFTH lord TRINE SUN OUT OF ANGLES predicts recovery of cattle.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Only a TRINE, no sextile.

rules.source_statement: Heading 'How far off a thing lost is from the owner' introduces angular-quarter distance method.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Distinct from subsequent livestock location methods.

rules.source_statement: Moon in same quarter as first lord and at most one sign apart means lost thing in owner's house or immediately near.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Required same zodiac quarter; one sign may be approximately thirty degrees.

rules.source_statement: More than thirty through seventy degrees within same relative quarter is said to locate property somewhere in owner's town.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This source degree range is not a measured town radius.

rules.source_statement: When Moon and first ruler are beyond ninety-degree same-quadrant condition, source describes object as far away.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Distance cutoffs approximate; other adjacent methods assign different units.

rules.source_statement: Heading 'BEASTS STOLEN OR STRAYED' introduces a comparison of the type of GOODS, FIXED versus MOVABLE, alongside Moon-house/second-lord separation.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: It is the GOODS that are fixed/movable, not a zodiac-sign modality alone.

rules.source_statement: When lunar domicile lord or second lord separates from its own domicile and missing goods are fixed, it is called stolen.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source's fixed/movable distinction applies to goods category and may be typographically ambiguous.

rules.source_statement: If the object is movable/live beast under analogous separation, it is said to have fled on its own.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The same separation is interpreted differently by object type.

rules.source_statement: SIXTH LORD ANGULAR suggests SMALL-GROWTH animals in CLOSES/POUNDS/HOUSES; SUCCEDENT nearby PASTURE; CADENT in COMMON GOING AWAY.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Keep small-growth, common and house-dependent alternatives.

rules.source_statement: SIXTH LORD in FIERY sign suggests EAST, woods or burnt brush; BUT when ANGULAR the direction is replaced by CLOSES, POUND or UNDER LOCK.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The original 'BUT' makes the angular branch an alternative rather than simple additive detail.

rules.source_statement: SIXTH LORD in EARTHY sign suggests DRY SOUTHERN land; if ANGULAR, in CLOSE/POUND with MUD WALL; if SUCCEDENT, ABOUT CLOSES ON RIGHT HAND OF QUERENT.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: CLOSES means enclosures/fields, not 'closer'; no additional cadent clause supplied.

rules.source_statement: For SIXTH LORD in AIRY signs: generally PLAIN GROUND; ANGULAR means POUND/HOUSE WESTWARD; SUCCEDENT means RIGHT HAND WESTWARD; CADENT means LEFT, GOING AWAY-WARD, straying FURTHER FROM RIGHT OWNER.
